create_granitemoehybrid_config: create a GraniteMoeHybridConfig instance with custom hidden_size and num_hidden_layers
build_layer_types_custom: build a GraniteMoeHybridConfig with a custom layer_types list mixing mamba and attention layers
test_mamba_layer_ids: test the mamba_layer_ids property to get indices of all mamba layers in the config
test_attention_layer_ids: test the attention_layer_ids property to get indices of all attention layers in the config
get_mamba2_cache_params: get the mamba2_cache_params property to retrieve Mamba2 cache parameters for the config
